comparator.name: Bachelor Marine Technology
comparator.academicYear: 2026–2027 adopted OER; ordinary current entrant requirements
comparator.sourceNotes: The current 2026–2027 Mechanical Engineering/Marine Technology OER, Marine curriculum table and BEP conditions (PDF pp.30–31), was freshly retrieved and visually inspected on 8 October 2026. Its ordinary requirements control over the live webpage older category allocation and chart. Year one comprises mathematics 12 EC, mechanics 24 EC, marine theory 16 EC and Integration and Skills 1/2 totaling 8 EC: 60. Year two comprises mathematics 12, Advanced Mechanics 6, Systems and Control Engineering 6, marine theory 18, Ship Design 6 and Integration and Skills 3 at 12: 60. Year three comprises a genuine 30-EC minor, Dynamics of Marine Structures 6, Electrical Drive and Conversion 4, Ship Motions and Manoeuvring 6 and Bachelor Final Project 14: 60. All 26 individual course/project/minor components total 180 EC. Integration and Skills 1/2/3 total 20 EC; Ship Design is a separate required 6-EC project within the listed 180, not an added duplicate. Mathematics and advanced-mechanics subparts remain embedded in their parent weights. Current MT1466-26 supersedes the older MT1466 code. The formal 14-EC final project replaces the old webpage 12-EC allocation. Its current entry requirement is all first-year courses and at least 54 second-year EC. No outdated ship-production/complex-loads category is carried into the current final-year list or independently added.
